LICENSED_OR_PERMITTED.description: A license, publisher policy, ownership record, or permission expressly covers the intended edit and destination platform(s).

PLATFORM_REMIX.description: Use is available only through an owner-enabled native feature under the platform's current terms and the original platform/account settings.

COPYRIGHT_EXCEPTION_CANDIDATE.description: A specific excerpt is proposed for criticism, analysis, commentary, or another potentially applicable exception. Candidate status is not a legal conclusion or monetization clearance.

UNUSABLE.description: Prohibited, access-controlled without an allowed route, unidentified, materially mismatched, or lacking any recorded production basis.

rights_checks: A public URL, official account, creator credit, watermark status, added narration, or short duration does not automatically grant rights.
Assess the gameplay recording, broadcast, game/publisher content, music, overlays, and third-party contributions separately where relevant.
Never bypass DRM, login controls, robots rules, proxy policy, rate limits, or platform restrictions.
Do not reuse one platform's native remix permission for downloading, offline editing, or cross-posting.
Copyright exceptions are jurisdiction-specific. Record evidence both for and against, and do not mark monetization eligibility as guaranteed.
